description: Single source of truth for deliverable-detection. Maps each expected ARB deliverable category to its consumer skill and the signals used to detect it. Read by assets/scripts/detect-deliverables.ps1 AND cited by any generated doc/README. Never duplicate this table into a .md or hard-code it in a script.

confidence.rule: High = category name or an unambiguous signal present in the file name/extension/path; Medium = plausible by one weak signal (keyword, folder) needing a content check; Low = only a loose hint. Never emit High without a clear, cited piece of evidence (name, extension or path). An ambiguous file (two categories at Medium or below) is reported as an open question, never silently classified.

categories.label: Functional architecture / backlog / statement of needs / user journey / business process
categories.notes: Business functional view, application interactions, user profiles/localization/access mode. Diagrams count when they live under a functional-architecture folder.

categories.label: Technical architecture / stack / documented patterns
categories.notes: Target technical architecture, AWS/landing-zone design, stack with versions, deployment steps. The DAT itself (a .docx) is the primary artefact.

categories.label: Dataflow / already-mapped flows
categories.notes: Flow/pipeline diagrams and flow-mapping tables. Feeds the technical-architecture skill's Data Flow Mapping deliverable. Distinct from the generic technical-architecture diagram; disambiguate by the 'flow/acquisition/pipeline' signal.

categories.label: Data classification / GDPR notes / sensitivity
categories.notes: Any pre-existing data classification, DICT/CIAT rating, GDPR/privacy note. Also mined from NFR or architecture docs when no dedicated file exists.

categories.label: Cost-estimable backlog / AWS Calculator exports / received quotes
categories.notes: AWS Calculator exports, supplier quotes, any cost sheet. May also derive from a sizeable technical stack + environments list.

categories.label: Already-assigned PRD/REFLEX codes
categories.notes: Application role matrices and already-attributed PRD/REFLEX codes. A PRD/REFLEX code may also appear inside another document.

categories.label: Non-Functional Requirements document
categories.notes: The NFR workbook (prefer .xlsm/.xlsx). Mandatory for Gate 2 (template slide 18).

categories.label: ARB/TCC deck already started by the project owner
categories.notes: An existing ARB/TCC .pptx is a base to COMPLETE, never to rebuild from scratch (presentation-gates reuses it).

categories.label: Any existing threat / vulnerability data
categories.notes: Pre-existing threat scenarios, STRIDE-LM tables or vulnerability notes. Classified data: keep internal, never route to an unvalidated external tool.
